intermediate.why: The placement march and both rate bisections are engine-only, and the placement explorer ran only the two published jobs. W4a adds a Your job view with a box for every input of a lead-and-tail placement (opening on the lessons' slant job), run through jobVolumes and simulatePlacement with both edges bisected. The brief now names the view. Prompt only.
prompt_edits: Six placement numbers for the Associate capstone's job.
Six placement numbers for the Associate capstone's job. Type that job, with the fluids, Fann sets, rate and limit below, into the placement explorer's Your job view.

end_pump_pressure_pa.notes: W4a typed-case mode (Your job view). Key, expected and tolerance unchanged.
end_pump_pressure_pa.source_ref: src/components/course/panels/cementing/PlacementExplorer.jsx Your job view, slant trajectory, every box typed with the Associate capstone job and the Professional fluids, Fann sets, rate 0.028 and limit 1600
end_pump_pressure_pa.display_ref: src/components/course/panels/cementing/PlacementExplorer.jsx Your job Tile 'End pump pressure' fmt(v/1e6, 6)
end_pump_pressure_pa.evidence: Typing the capstone job into the Your job view reproduces capstonePlacement exactly and prints this value at 6 dp in MPa, within its tol of the key (panelCapstoneGuard.test.js 'THE ROUTE'). The view opens on the lessons' slant job (identical to placementFor('slant', 'lead_tail')), which prints no graded answer.
